notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1.0 adds new balloons and baskets to the game and fixed lot of issues.

Changes

Added 3 new ballons
Added 5 new baskets
Tutorial - fixed issues with start position
Difficulty settings - fixed choosing by mouse
Set boundaries for level 3 and level 7
Added signs to level 4, 5 and 7 for better orientation 
Fixed english and czech translation
HUD - fixed for different resolutions
Cutscenes - fixed texts overflow
Added decorations to some levels
Level complete screen - fixed missing mouse cursor
Fixed multiple loading scenes 
And lot more...
